title: Ambient-Algebra Independence of Exchangeable Independence
exact_target: Determine whether the proposed exchangeability definition of independence intrinsically depends on the ambient algebra.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001182 (OWR-3392-009). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Product Systems and Independence in Quantum Dynamics (2009), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2009/09, pp. 493--548; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 48--49, printed pages 540--541.

status_qualification: The comparison must retain the subalgebras, their states, and joint distribution while changing ambient embeddings. The question is not whether arbitrary embeddings preserve an unrelated probability law. The source itself identifies possible embedding dependence as unresolved.
